explain.label: Cash at the start of 01 Nov

options.label: Mobile-wallet digital nano loan
options.anchored_on: City Bank and bKash Digital Nano Loan
options.note: A retail loan to the owner personally: check it may be used for a business bill. Limit raised to Tk 50,000 and tenure to six months (June 2025 report); 9% a year per the launch coverage.

options.label: Bank collateral-free CMSME loan
options.note: A business loan. Promotional rate 'as low as 13.75%' for August and September 2025. Processing time is not stated in the source; 14 days is LaMP's assumption.

options.label: Microfinance enterprise loan
options.note: A business loan. Source: microfinance institutions charge 'upwards of 20 per cent'; 20% is the lower bound. Membership and weekly instalments are typical.

options.label: Mobile-wallet Pay Later
options.anchored_on: City Bank and bKash Pay Later
options.ineligible_reason: The supplier isn't known to take wallet merchant payments.
options.note: Only for purchases at wallet merchants. Free if repaid within 7 days; otherwise it becomes a three-month loan at 9% a year. For purchases at wallet merchants.

options.label: Bank working-capital loan under the CMSME refinance fund
options.anchored_on: Bangladesh Bank Tk 5,000 crore revolving CMSME working-capital refinance fund
options.ineligible_reason: Takes about 21 days; the money is needed in 16.
options.note: A business loan. Banks may charge end borrowers at most 9%; revolving fund with a three-year tenure and a 3–6 month grace period; CIB-classified borrowers are not eligible. Processing time is not stated in the source; 21 days is LaMP's assumption for a bank loan.

options.label: B2B platform credit for retailers
options.ineligible_reason: The supplier isn't known to sell through this platform; its price isn't published, so it can't be compared.
options.note: A business loan. Credit for retailers buying through the platform; pricing isn't published, so LaMP can't compare its cost.
